prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Make the iPad meeting-notes workflow usable from a hardware keyboard. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS. Custom editor swallows Command-C, Tab loops only between decoration, toolbar commands have no shortcuts and Escape unexpectedly deletes the current note. Software keyboard is the only way to submit a search.

criteria.task_completion: Patch standard editing shortcuts, complete focus/activation and sensible submit/cancel behavior, discoverable app-specific commands and no conflict with system accessibility shortcuts.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the keyboards guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch standard editing shortcuts, complete focus/activation and sensible submit/cancel behavior, discoverable app-specific commands and no conflict with system accessibility shortcuts.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Patch standard editing shortcuts, complete focus/activation and sensible submit/cancel behavior, discoverable app-specific commands and no conflict with system accessibility shortcuts.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
